title: ml-drought-modeling-studies: code for forecasting the storage of the Cantareira Water Supply System
description: Code for the forecasting paper on the total storage of the Cantareira Water Supply System (São Paulo Metropolitan Region, Brazil), 3 and 12 months ahead, with XGBoost and LSTM models and their interpretation (SHAP, saliency, perturbation). Reproduces every figure and table of the paper. Input data: HydroShare (see related identifiers). Developed at LabSid, Escola Politécnica, Universidade de São Paulo.
